text:
marie: Hey folks — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/53621 needs runtime + infra + security signoff before we can merge. Change is a smaller KV prefetch window + eviction metrics. CI is green. Can we get owners and a merge window? Ideally today 18:00 UTC. cc @max (runtime) @devon (infra) @anya (security)
sam: I can take infra review in ~30m, will check the flaky test history.
max: looking now — quick note: local microbench shows ~5% p50 improvement for long sequences. Adding a short perf note to the PR.
anya: security quick heads-up: need a KMS usage callout and a short risk line in the PR description. I can add the comment, but prefer the author add it.
devon: re CI — one flaky integration on redis-backed cache popped earlier, suggest a rerun: `/retest`
infra-bot: @marie retest triggered by @devon — CI jobs queued (eviction-integration, unit, lint)
max: smoke command I ran: `./scripts/run_eviction_bench --model gpt-1b --seq 1024` shows p50 5% lower, p95 ~2% lower. Pushed the numbers to PR comment.
sam: quick skim — config change looks fine; want infra owner to confirm no rollout infra changes required.
ops-bot: Merge window note: available slots today: 18:00 UTC or 21:00 UTC. Recommended canary rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m. Example snippet to attach: ```canary: [10,50,100]
step_minutes: 10```
marie: thanks — i'll add the KMS callout, and if @anya is happy with the wording i'll target 18:00 UTC slot and tag ops for the canary. If infra has objections we can shift to 21:00.
anya: LGTM assuming the KMS line is present. I'll re-review the PR comment in ~15m.
marie: perfect — i'll update PR description now and ping back once done. merging schedule: tentatively 1769879200 (18:00 UTC).
